04 PERFORMANCE SESSION

Film your DJ set in Limassol.

A promoter watching your set wants to see you work. We’re developing a session with a wide performance shot, an angle on the decks and a clean stereo feed. It can start with an artist interview and run straight into the mix.

Plan a DJ set ↗Session rates ↗

01 SESSION NOTES

The performer, the decks and the mix.

01

What to bring

Tell us which decks or controller you normally play on, how you bring your tracks and whether you need space for extra equipment. We’ll confirm the available setup before quoting.

02

Choose the handoff

Some artists want the complete set. Others need a short promo cut for a promoter or three vertical excerpts. Pick the outputs before the session so we can frame for them and allow the right editing time.

03

Recording and going live

A recorded set and a public stream require different preparation. For a live session we’ll agree the destination, confirm what music you can broadcast, and do a private sound and picture check first.

02 BEFORE YOU RECORD

Good questions.

How much does a filmed DJ set cost?

DJ sessions are quoted by set length, lighting, technician time and deliverables. The podcast rental figures are a separate price list.

Can I book the room just to practise?

Include that in your brief. The performance offer is being developed around recording, so an equipment list and an agreed room slot come first.

Choose a starting point and save a brief. Pilot prices and dates are confirmed separately.
